label: R1 FINAL TEST EVALUATION -- Beijing test 2014, evaluated exactly once
comparability_caveat: This is a comparison against a published reference result, NOT a claim of exact replication. Documented methodological differences: reduced STN (2 encoder / 1 decoder vs. the paper's 3/2); chronological validation split vs. the paper's random validation split; an explicit anti-leakage protocol for missing-data interpolation not described in the paper; MinMax scaling fit exclusively on TRAIN, whereas the paper does not specify its fitting scope; and our own choices for d_model, heads, d_ff, dropout, factor and decoder label length, none of which the paper reports. See docs/IMPLEMENTATION_ASSUMPTIONS.md.
